## Provider or service

Name the desired routing selection and explain the use case.

## Public source

Link to an official publication or maintained community feed. State whether it lists destination domains, destination IP ranges, or something else.

## Scope and maintenance

Describe update frequency, license or attribution terms, and known gaps. For IP ranges, explain why the allocations belong to the provider rather than shared hosting.
